user.title: Pantry Inventory
user.description: Choose the shopping list that running-low products are added to, and the stores you shop at (optional).

data_description.shopping_list: Any to-do list, such as Home Assistant's Shopping List, Local To-do or Bring!.
data_description.stores: Names you can give a product as its usual store, such as Costco. Leave empty if you don't need them.

abort.already_configured: Pantry Inventory is already set up.
abort.no_lists: No to-do list found. Add one first (for example the Shopping List integration), then set up Pantry Inventory.

data_description.shopping_list: Where products are added when they run low. Changing it doesn't move items already on the old list.
data_description.stores: Names you can give a product as its usual store.
